title: Specimen One
summary: The Rio Negro, June 2767. One of your kind calls from a crate at the men's river station. Another pack holds the forest between you and her. Answer her, and take her home.

sides.name: The Sire's Pack
sides.about: The Tyrant Sire, the Old Mother and their pack, out of the deep forest.

sides.name: The Rival Pack
sides.about: Another pack, holding the forest above the station.

sides.name: The Station
sides.about: The Academy's station on the Rio Negro, the Crown's fort at São Gabriel and the mission village.

objectives.text: ROOT: select the Tyrant Sire, press ROOT and set him down inside the ring round the Old Mother (her father range). Rooted, he is the nest her warrior eggs hatch in.

LAY AND HATCH: select the Old Mother and lay two Raptor eggs. They roll into the Sire's nest, he breathes on them and they hatch ({raptors} of 6 Raptors). More creatures need more supply: a grub turns into a MOUND TURTLE (BUILD).
THE SIRE'S ROAR: UPROOT the Sire and walk him to the forest's edge above the station. There he roars, and she answers.
LINNEA: root the Sire beside her pen (here he may nest far from the Old Mother). While he lies there she lays her clutch ({eggs} of 5). Rooted he cannot bite: keep the pack round him.
Take her home: walk the Sire back to the Old Mother's den. Linnea follows at his heels.

GROW SOUTH: the den's swamp feeds only a few Rootmaws. Walk a grub down the back way south of the den and turn it into a MOUND TURTLE (BUILD) there: its swamp feeds more Rootmaws, and more food means more eggs.
Drive the rival pack off: kill its Mother.
Kill the Tyrant Sire or the Old Mother before she is home.

choice.title: Her clutch lies in the trampled straw.

options.label: TAKE THE CLUTCH
options.about: The Sire carries the eggs home in his jaws: slower, and he cannot bite until she is home. The men will have nothing of hers.

options.label: LEAVE IT
options.about: Go now, fast, with her alone. The clutch stays in the burning straw, for the fire or for the men.

k_open1.text: Two letters came that year. The first came from the Amazon, from the Crown's mapmaker.

k_open2.text: The naturalist they brought me in chains. He knows these creatures better than any man alive. Let him tell it.

l_open1.text: I was the happiest man in the world that summer, Majesty. Write that down, whoever writes.

l_open2.text: The Academy's station at the rapids of São Gabriel. The river high, the forest standing in the water.

l_open3.text: She came from an egg a trader found after the flood. In forty days she had trebled.

l_open5.text: I watched the forest from my window every evening. That week, Majesty, the forest watched back.

l_1.text: Something moved in the deep forest that week. Pieter said the birds had gone quiet to the north.

l_2.text: I wrote it down and thought nothing of it. I had a pen to finish.

l_weigh.text: She called at sunset, as every day. Eleven pounds heavier than Monday. Nothing answered. Not yet.

n_canoe.text: A canoe came down from the boundary survey: the Crown's mapmaker, Duarte Valadares.

v_1.text: Doctor. They say at the fort you keep a lizard the size of a dog.

l_v1.text: Not a lizard. Something no man has named. The Crown will have a cavalry that needs no hay.

v_2.text: You mean to sell this to the army, Doctor? Then why do you whisper when you speak of her?

p_tracks2.text: Three toes, deep in the mud at the creek. Too many to count.

v_tracks.text: There are two kinds of track up there, Doctor. Two packs, and both came down from the north.

l_tracks.text: Then she has a family. Two families. Splendid.

l_kin.text: Did you see them hunt? Not one beast. A breed, with a breed's manners.

n_call.text: At dusk a roar came out of the forest, and she answered it.

l_call.text: Listen. Listen to that. She knows that voice.

v_tell.text: Send to Teles, Doctor. Tell him what is in the forest, and bring the village in before dark.

l_quiet.text: If Teles sees those tracks he will shoot everything in this forest, beginning with her. One night.

l_one_night.text: So I kept it quiet, Majesty. One night, I said. The Crown would have its beasts tame or not at all.

n_eve.text: The Eve of Saint John. Rain on the river, and the bonfires lit at Nazaré.

l_lure1.text: I had made a lure from the shell of her egg and her own musk. Pieter set it in three jars at the forest's edge.

l_lure2.text: Any of her kind that smelt it would stand at the jar sniffing like a dog, and we would be waiting with the guns.

v_lure.text: You are calling something you have never seen, Doctor, to a house full of people.

l_stallion.text: I am calling a stallion for my mare. By morning the Academy will have a pair.

p_set.text: All three jars are open, Doctor. I can smell it from here.

p_past.text: Doctor, they walked past the jars.

v_past.text: They are not after your scent. They are going to her.

p_sire.text: Over the palisade. Doctor, it is as big as the house.

l_lost.text: He walked through my station as if it were reeds. He did not want us. He wanted her.

v_lost.text: We cannot hold this place. Get the people to the jetty. Benedito has his canoes.

v_fire.text: Fire the thatch! They shy from fire. It buys us the jetty.

t_late.text: Shots at the station! You three, with me, along the causeway. Hold the ford for them.

j_raid.text: The station is burning! Down to the boats, all of you, in the name of God!

l_groom.text: He did not want to eat her. He lay down beside her like a groom.

p_eggs.text: Doctor, there are eggs in her straw.

l_young.text: She is too young. She is far too young.

l_five.text: Five eggs. Five. And he lay across the gate and would not let a man near.

n_taken.text: The pen broke like kindling, and she followed him.

l_taken.text: No. No! She is mine! Shoot him, not her!

v_taken.text: Let her go, Doctor. Your notes, your people. Now.

n_room.text: The specimen house was alight. Her eggs lay in the trampled straw.

v_burn.text: Burn them, Doctor. Whatever she was, do not carry her children down this river.

l_save.text: Ten years of work. The Crown's beasts are in that straw. I will not leave them to the fire.

l_crate.text: The crate, Pieter. The notes on top. I carry it myself.

l_gone.text: The straw was empty. I thought the fire had taken them. I believed that for thirty years.

l_pieter.text: Pieter. Pieter did not come back from the forest's edge.

n_leave.text: The last canoe pushed off with the station burning behind it.

l_end1.text: We went down the river at first light with the station burning behind us. She was gone. He took her from me as a thief takes a horse.

l_end_saved.text: I had the research. I told the Academy I had saved my notes. That was the first lie.

l_end_fire.text: The fire took her eggs before I reached them. I had nothing left but my word, and no one wanted it.

l_end_pieter.text: Pieter sat in the canoe with the specimen book on his knees and did not speak all day.

l_end_nopieter.text: Pieter went to the forest's edge with the jars. I have his specimen book still. He does not.

l_end_two.text: There were two packs in that forest, Majesty, and they fought over her like dogs over a bone. I saw it from my window.

l_end_north.text: Valadares turned his canoe round at the first island. He went north after her, up the creek, to the mountain in the cloud.

l_end2.text: I meant to give the Crown its beasts, Majesty. I still think I was right.

k_end1.text: He wrote that his lure called them. It did not. She called them, and they came for her.

k_end2.text: She was never stolen. She went home.

k_end_saved.text: And what he carried out of the fire was not research. It was her children.

k_end_taken.text: And the fire took nothing. The pack carried her eggs north in its jaws. He never knew.

new_tyrannosaur.text: NEW: THE TYRANT SIRE. A grub becomes him. Rooted by the Mother, he fathers her warrior eggs; up, he fights; his ROAR calls the pack.

new_raptor.text: NEW: THE RAPTORS. Pick them on the Mother's card: an egg of quick biters that hatches in the Sire's nest. Many and fast; weak alone.

letter.caption: Rome, the present. The King with the mapmaker's letter.

station.caption: The Academy's station at the rapids of São Gabriel, June 2767.

teller.caption: Rome, the present. The naturalist in chains before the King.

text: The Rio Negro, June 2767, the Eve of Saint John. One of your kind calls from a crate at the men's station by the river.
Another pack holds the forest between your den and her. Root, lay, hatch. Let the Sire roar at the forest's edge, and take her home.
The Old Mother and the Tyrant Sire must live.
The Rio Negro, June 2767. Another pack has come down out of the north for the young one in the men's pen.
Hold the forest. Kill their Sire or their Mother before she is home.

sire.title: She is home
sire.text: The Tyrant Sire's pack broke Linnea out of her pen and took her home to the Old Mother's den. Behind them the station burned, and its people went down the river in Benedito's canoes.

text_if.text: Most of the men got away in the boats: {saved} of {people}.
Some of the men got away in the boats: {saved} of {people}.
Few of the men got away in the boats: {saved} of {people}.
The Sire carried her clutch home. The men think the fire took it.
The clutch was left. Lindqvist carried it out of the fire in a crate.
The rival pack's Mother is dead: the forest is the Sire's.
The rival pack still holds the forest above the river.

rival.title: The pack is broken
rival.text: The rival pack held the forest, and Linnea stayed in her pen. Try again: the Old Mother and the Tyrant Sire must live.
